whatsappMessage:
Hi Team Sangita,

I noticed your store has incredible 4.2★ ratings with over 1,140 reviews on Buddh Marg in Patna, but lacked a dedicated mobile web page for customer inquiries and catalog browsing.

Maine aapke business ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp order/inquiry, store timings, aur location directions integrate kiye hain:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/sangita

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Team Sangita, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Sangita opposite Patna Museum) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp inquiry, mobile-first speed, and a showcase of your prime Buddh Marg location. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact products aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain."
